newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria shortlists telecoms sale advisers.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria shortlists telecoms sale advisers.

text.p: Bulgaria's cabinet has shortlisted six banks from the 18 who bid to advise the government in the planned sale of 25 percent of Bulgarian Telecommunications Company, Deputy Prime Minister Doncho Konakchiev said on Thursday.

State news agency BTA quoted Konakchiev, who is also minister of territorial development and construction, as saying the six must submit documents by December 20 and the government will make its choice by January 31.
He listed the six as Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Merrill Lynch, SBC Warburg, Goldman Sachs, Nat West Markets, and BZW.
The sale of a stake in the state telecommunications firm, which had 1995 turnover of $244.6 million, is a key part of the heavily-indebted government's privatisation programme.
Privatisation Agency director Vesselin Blagoev said earlier on Thursday a new telecommunications law, currently being drafted, should be in place by the first quarter of 1997.
He said bids from international telecommunications companies could be invited around the end of the second quarter or the beginning of the third quarter.
